note: Functions this project has reconstructed from the disassembly and pinned with a compile-probe case. The provider's own boundaries are wrong for most of them -- its body covers only the dispatch head and the arms are separate entries -- so each entry here carries the extent measured against the image and the probe case that proves it. Both `export_src.py` and `export_ranges.py` apply this file, so the projection and the committed range fixture cannot disagree about where a recovered function ends. `source` names the constant in tools/compile_probe.py that holds the reconstruction; that string is what `src/<image>/<name>.c` publishes for these functions.
